name: gizza-ai/hex-view
summary: Render a file as a hex dump

tool.description: Render any file as a classic hex dump — an 8-digit hex offset column, the bytes in hex (grouped 8+8), and an ASCII gutter (like `xxd`). bytes_per_line (1-64, default 16) sets the row width; max_bytes (default 4096, hard cap 262144) limits how much is shown. Returns the dump text plus total/shown byte counts. Provide the file as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior tool call).

url.description: File URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

max_bytes.description: Maximum number of bytes to dump (default 4096, hard cap 262144). Use to view more or less of a large file.
